usageNotes: Use this to register a new external metrics backend (Graphite, InfluxDB, or OpenTelemetry) that all cluster nodes will push performance data to. The `type` field determines which set of optional params apply: InfluxDB HTTP v2 needs `bucket`, `organization`, and `token`; Graphite needs `path` and optionally `proto`; OpenTelemetry uses the `otel-*` params. Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/` — API tokens must explicitly hold this privilege.

examples.summary: Add an InfluxDB v2 HTTP metrics server

tips: The `id` path param must match the pve-configid format (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, no spaces) and must be unique across all existing metric server entries.
For InfluxDB v1 compatibility API, omit `organization` and use `user:password` as the `token` value.
Set `disable: true` to register the config without activating it — useful for staging before cutover.
UDP (the InfluxDB default) has no delivery guarantee; switch to `influxdbproto: http` or `https` for reliable delivery in production.
OpenTelemetry `otel-headers` and `otel-resource-attributes` must be base64-encoded JSON strings.
